notes.title: Free Steam Keys! New Trailer! Gamescom!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
this is JINO Games

We are excited to bring you several updates and news today.

[previewyoutube=kU1OgtZR99k;full][/previewyoutube]A new Story Trailer for Goodbye Seoul has been released!
Enjoy the scenary as you scroll through the BIG updates below.

[h1][b][Review & Wishlist Event][/b][/h1]
Goodbye Seoul has opened a brand new Demo page on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2711590/_/
Players can not leave a review directly on the Demo store page for Goodbye Seoul.
To celebrate, we're kicking off a special Review Event just for you!

[h2][b]Event Schedule[/b][/h2]
📅 Event Period: August 14th, 2024 - August 28th, 2024
🏆 Winner Announcements: September 4th

[h2][b]How to participate:[/b][/h2]
1️⃣ Wishlist 'Goodbye Seoul' on Steam
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/f98bdb7ab9cc25f4197b0d572ad49887254c5f8f.gif[/img]

2️⃣ Leave a review for 'Goodbye Seoul' on Steam!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/9d626abc7595d4adfcd5f5ad07da2312b4b891bd.gif[/img]

3️⃣ Submit a screenshot to the form below
👉 https://forms.gle/QHhCQDJqXpZWbiYf6


[h2][b]Prize[/b][/h2]
🎁 Prize: Steam Gift Card OR a Steam Key for Goodbye Seoul 
🏆Winners: We will be awarding Steam Gift Cards to the 2 most actively participating individuals,
and Steam keys to additional 15 individuals selected through a random draw!
- Steam Gift Card ($25.00) - 2 winners
- Goodbye Seoul Steam Key - 15 winners

[h2][b]Notice[/b][/h2]
- Event schedules and details are subject to change depending on the situation.
- Winners will be contacted via the email address provided in the form.
- If the information in the form is entered incorrectly, it may be difficult to provide the prize.
- The winners will be announced on September 4th, and rewards will be distributed sequentially starting from September 13th.
- Rewards will be sent out sequentially from the distribution date, and the time of receipt may vary for each individual.
- Steam keys will be distributed upon the official release of Goodbye Seoul.
- Please note that the Steam Gift Cards may be automatically converted to your local currency at the exchange rate applicable at the time of redemption.


[h1][b][Demo Update][/b][/h1]
Additionally, we want to thank everyone who has played the demo and provided valuable feedback.
We've improved the demo to its latest version with the following key changes:
[h2][b]Changes Made[/b][/h2]
- Fixed UI and text errors
- Fixed a bug where the Steam achievement could not be unlocked
- Fixed camera effect bugs
- Improved sound and audio
- Removed the Unity logo

[h1][b][Gamescom 2024][/b][/h1]
Finally, we are thrilled to announce that 'Goodbye Seoul' will be participating in the Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom 2024!
The booth will be open from August 21st to August 25th at Gamescom IAB Hall 10.2, S29.
We look forward to seeing you there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/2ea31d0c467e07e93b06d46d4b5f94385a8694a2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/4ff33a08d8534efb2ddee352a3241e483d2e383f.jpg[/img]
Thank you.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/sCkwJeKmAr


Twitter: https://x.com/GoodByeSeoul_

notes.title: New Languages Support and Enhanced English Translation
notes.content:
Hello from the Goodbye Seoul Team!

We are thrilled to announce our latest update, which brings the much-awaited language support and significant improvements to your gaming experience

What's new:

[h2][b]Language Support[/b][/h2]
We have added support for Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), and Chinese (Traditional).
Now you can enjoy the immersive world of Goodbye Seoul in these languages, making your gaming experience more comfortable and enjoyable.

[h2][b]Enhanced English Translation[/b][/h2]
We've also taken a critical look at our existing English version and made extensive improvements. 
This update brings more polished and nuanced English translations across the board, ensuring a smoother and more engaging gameplay experience for our English-speaking players.
Furthermore, we've changed the English title from 'GoodbyeSeoul: Itaewon' to 'Goodbye Seoul' in order to deliver a better understanding of the game to our English-speaking audience.

[h2][b]Minor Improvements[/b][/h2][list]
[*] Improved animations
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[*] Added a Profanity Filter
[*] Changed the English title of the game[/list]
We are deeply committed to ensuring Goodbye Seoul is as welcoming and inclusive as possible. 
We’d love to hear your feedback on these new language options and any suggestions for future updates."

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. 
Dive back into the richer, more inclusive world of Goodbye Seoul—and may your adventures be grander than ever.
